description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user information retrieval, including the query, validation, and handler to fetch user details by username.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to fetch user details by username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the query to ensure Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to retrieve user information, throws exception if user not found, and maps data to user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve user data from the database, generate JWT token, and return user envelope.
